# GlobalPathwayHub

> GlobalPathwayHub is a premier international higher education consulting agency and global university admissions advisory. We connect prospective students with accredited universities and degree programs across Malaysia, Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, France, the United States, Germany, and Ireland.

## Overview & Core Capabilities

GlobalPathwayHub empowers students, university counselors, and international academic partners through transparent, ethical, and technology-driven admissions guidance. Our platform offers real-time worldwide institutional searches, verified tuition fee insights, secure document verification, and direct counselor communication desks.

- **Official Website:** [GlobalPathwayHub](https://globalpathwayhub.com)
- **Headquarters Office:** 6-A, Jass Nibash, Section-10, Block-B, Road Avenue-1, Plot-5, Mirpur-10, Mirpur, Dhaka - 1216.
- **Coordinates:** 23.809391, 90.368409
- **Regional Operations:** Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia · London, United Kingdom
- **Admissions Helpdesk:** support@globalpathwayhub.com · +880 1410-555054
- **Working Hours:** Sunday – Thursday, 09:30 AM – 06:30 PM (GMT+6)

## University Admissions & Destinations

GlobalPathwayHub facilitates direct undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral admissions to accredited institutions across key destinations:

- [Malaysia Admissions](https://globalpathwayhub.com/universities?country=Malaysia): Affordable world-class branch campuses, EMGS eVAL processing, dual-degree qualifications.
- [Canada Admissions](https://globalpathwayhub.com/universities?country=Canada): Provincial Attestation Letters (PAL), PGWP up to 3 years, DLI accredited institutions.
- [Australia Admissions](https://globalpathwayhub.com/universities?country=Australia): Group of Eight (Go8) & top Australian tech universities, Subclass 500 visa filing, 2-4 yr Subclass 485 stay.
- [United Kingdom Admissions](https://globalpathwayhub.com/universities?country=United+Kingdom): Russell Group & top UK modern universities, CAS issuance, fast 1-year Master's, 2-yr Graduate Route.
- [France Admissions](https://globalpathwayhub.com/universities?country=France): Subsidized public & Grandes Écoles business degrees, CAF housing aid, 2-year APS stay-back visa.
- [United States Admissions](https://globalpathwayhub.com/universities?country=United+States): Tier-1 research universities, 36-month STEM OPT extensions, I-20 documentation, F-1 visa interview prep.
- [Germany & Ireland Admissions](https://globalpathwayhub.com/universities?country=Germany): Low/zero tuition German public universities (18-mo Job Seeker visa) & Irish EU tech hubs (2-yr stay-back).

## Academic Degree Levels

- **Undergraduate Degrees (Bachelor's / B.Sc / BBA / B.Eng):** 3-4 year comprehensive bachelor programs.
- **Postgraduate Degrees (Master's / M.Sc / MBA / M.Res):** 1-2 year specialized graduate degrees.
- **Doctoral Programs (PhD / D.Eng):** 3-5 year advanced research fellowships and funded doctorates.
- **Foundation & University Pathways:** Pre-master and international year one programs for seamless transition.

## Key Website Directories & Endpoints

- [Universities Directory](https://globalpathwayhub.com/universities): Search, filter, and compare partner and worldwide universities.
- [Courses & Programs](https://globalpathwayhub.com/courses): Explore degree courses with verified tuition fees, intake seasons, and eligibility criteria.
- [Student Survival Guide & Blog](https://globalpathwayhub.com/guide): Honest student field guides covering current study abroad reality, housing, legal part-time work caps, budgeting, and survival strategies.
- [Executive Leadership](https://globalpathwayhub.com/profile): Profiles, strategic responsibilities, and verified credentials of the leadership team.
- [About Us](https://globalpathwayhub.com/about): Mission, institutional values, achievements, and counseling philosophy.
- [Contact & Support](https://globalpathwayhub.com/contact): Direct admissions helpline, office location map, and counselor consultation booking.
- [Support Center & FAQ](https://globalpathwayhub.com/support): Detailed answers regarding document requirements, visa timelines, and application fees.
- [XML Sitemap](https://globalpathwayhub.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all published universities, courses, and pages.
